text: {"name":"query_rate_info","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Looks up a rate-info record, copies its fixed fields to the caller buffer, and copies optional 16-bit fields when their flags are set and the record is long enough.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a3":"output_buffer","v4":"rate_info_record","v5":"record_end","v8":"record_flags","v11":"optional_fields_cursor"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":6,"meaning":"Flags; bits 3 and 4 select optional 16-bit field pairs."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"First mandatory little-endian 16-bit rate-info value."},{"offset":22,"meaning":"Second mandatory little-endian 16-bit rate-info value."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Optional little-endian 16-bit pair when flag bit 3 is set; otherwise, the optional pair selected by bit 4 begins here."}]}
